prompt: # BUILD PROMPT — "RALLY: Pong, Reconsidered" Landing Page **ROLE:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete, production-ready landing page described below in a single attempt. Do not ask clarifying questions — make expert decisions where details are unspecified. **PROJECT BRIEF** - **Theme:** RALLY — pong, reconsidered. An interactive/game landing page for a minimalist, contemporary reimagining of classic Pong: a warm paper-like canvas, soft neumorphic surfaces, and recurring paddle-and-ball motifs. - **Era & Mood:** 2020s Contemporary — calm, tactile, playful but restrained. - **Palette:** Canvas `#f4f1ea`, raised surface `#fdfcf8`, ink `#191713`, warm gray `#a39d8f`. Pure `#ffffff` is forbidden anywhere; `#fdfcf8` is the theme's near-white. - **Signature Effects:** Neumorphism (soft dual shadows), hover effects, transitions, transforms, `aspect-ratio`. - **Required Sections (in order):** Sticky nav shell → Hero → Features (3 cards) → How It Works (3 steps) → Testimonials → Pricing (3 tiers) → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer with secondary links. - **All user-facing copy must be written in English.** ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **No inline styles:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID selectors only:** every design property, layout rule, and state lives in `style.css`. - **Style-agnostic markup:** retheming the entire page must require editing only the CSS file, never the HTML. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens Define the full token sheet in `:root` and reference everything via `var(--...)`: - **Colors:** `--primary: #191713` (ink — headings, primary buttons); `--secondary: #a39d8f` (warm gray — decorative accents, borders, secondary buttons); `--bg-primary: #f4f1ea` (page canvas); `--bg-secondary: #fdfcf8` (raised surfaces); `--text-primary: #191713`; `--text-secondary: #6f6a5c` (readable warm gray — **`#a39d8f` fails text contrast on `#f4f1ea`, so restrict it to decorative use only**); `--text-success: #3e7c58`; `--text-error: #b3432b`; `--border-default: rgba(163,157,143,0.4)`; `--border-error`; `--border-success`. - **Contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with dark text and every dark background with light text, in both themes. Body text ≥ 4.5:1, large text ≥ 3:1. - **Neumorphic depth tokens:** `--shadow-out` (raised, e.g. `6px 6px 14px rgba(25,23,19,0.14), -6px -6px 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.9)`), `--shadow-out-lg`, `--shadow-in` (pressed/inset), plus generic `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`; radii `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 16px`, `--radius-lg: 24px`; `--spacing-gap`; `--transition-fast: 150ms`; `--transition-normal: 250ms`; `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`; `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast` (defined even if unused). - **Typography tokens:** `--font-display: 'Space Grotesk'` (headings, scores, numerals), `--font-base: 'Inter'` (body). ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode - **Exception clause:** the source theme marks Light as the sole mode — Light remains the default experience, but dark mode must still be fully defined and toggleable. - **Implementation:** light defaults in `:root`; dark overrides in a `.dark` class **and** in `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` scoped as `:root:not(.light)`, so the explicit toggle always wins over the OS preference. Set the `color-scheme` property per theme so native controls adapt. - **Dark tokens derived from the palette:** `--bg-primary: #191713`, `--bg-secondary: #211e18`, `--text-primary: #fdfcf8`, `--text-secondary: #b3ac9d`, borders `rgba(163,157,143,0.28)`, lightened `--text-success`/`--text-error`, and **redefined neumorphic shadows** (deep black outer shadow + faint light rim, e.g. `8px 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), -8px -8px 18px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`). Every surface, card, button, and court must re-map with zero HTML changes. - **Toggle:** a visible header button using Google Material Symbols (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`) with `aria-pressed` and a descriptive `aria-label`; persist the choice in `localStorage`; fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First - Build all layout structure with Flexbox; **every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless there is an explicitly justified exception. - **Mobile-first:** rows collapse to columns on small viewports; **no horizontal scrolling at any width from 320px up**. ### 1.5 Framework - Use Tailwind CSS with component classes composed via `@layer` / `@apply` (or clean custom CSS mapped to the same tokens). All utilities must resolve to the variables above; reusable component classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, etc. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Only) - Load Space Grotesk + Inter via Google Fonts `` tags and bind them to the font tokens. - All icons via Google Material Symbols (Rounded variant): `…`. **Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.** ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Buttons (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger`) - **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`; minimum touch target 44×44px. Primary = ink fill with light text; secondary = neumorphic raised. Never rely on shadow alone for affordance — pair with clear labels and `cursor: pointer`. - **Hover:** deepened shadow or `translateY(-1px)`; **Focus:** distinct visible ring built from CSS variables; **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)` (neumorphic secondaries switch to `--shadow-in`); **Loading:** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks, shows a rotating Material Symbol spinner without distorting button dimensions; **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`; **Success/Error:** temporary feedback styles via `--text-success` / `--text-error`. Define `.btn--danger` as visually distinct in both themes. ### 2.2 Cards (`.card` — features, testimonials, pricing) - **Default:** flex column, `--radius-lg`, neumorphic raised on the canvas; **Hover:** `translateY(-2px)` plus deepened shadow; **Focus-within:** visible border accent (never shadow-only) when a child link/button receives focus — critical for keyboard users on neumorphic surfaces; **Loading:** a skeleton shimmer keyframe pattern; **Empty:** structured fallback with a Material Symbol and guidance text. ### 2.3 Form & Input (Final CTA email capture) - **Structure:** flex column — `
